Emily / Legal team,

Thanks again for the productive call last week — excited to get the MSA and Order Form in flight. To make the legal review efficient, can you confirm the following items from your side so we can assemble a first-pass package for both counsels: 

- Legal entity name for contracting (full legal name + address)
- Billing entity and billing contact (if different)
- Any required exhibits (DPA, SOC 2 evidence list, IP exhibit) you expect attached to an MSA
- Preferred signatory (name + title) and whether e-signature is acceptable
- Any non-standard procurement terms (PO required, net payment terms not 30)

Attached: OrderForm_v0.1.docx and MSA_template_redwood.docx for your review. If you can return redlines by EOD Thursday (11/06) that would keep us on the timeline to get an executed order before the end of the month.

Proposed next step: 30-minute sync Wednesday afternoon to walk through any high-level concerns before counsel digs in. Does 3:30pm PT work for you?

Thanks — I’ll loop in finance/procurement as needed once we have party details.

Best,

Thanks — saw Emily’s note and the redlines. Quick internal thoughts before the sync: 

- Data processing: their DPA ask looks standard but we should confirm whether they require subprocessors listed up front or allow a general subprocessors clause with notice. Recommend we offer our standard DPA and mark the subprocessor language for discussion.
- Retention: they want shorter retention windows for logs; propose we offer a compromise (production data retention 90 days, aggregated telemetry 1 year) and flag any product limitations to Chloe.
- Indemnity/cap: counsel pushed for a lower cap tied to fees; we should propose a 12-month fees cap with carveouts for IP infringement.
- PO/net-45: finance will need an internal exception for net-45 vs our typical net-30; I’ll add finance to the Wednesday invite if Rishi confirms.

I attached a short internal commentary doc (redline_comments_internal.docx) that outlines the three items I think we should prioritize in the sync and which clauses to keep on the table. Lauren

Lauren Bishop
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com
